title: DART announces the launch of its new Airbus H135 external cargo Heli-Utility-Basket
summary: The new product has received a Transport Canada Civil Aviation supplemental type certificate SH26-34.
body_markdown:
DART Aerospace has announced the launch of its new external cargo Heli-Utility-Basket, specifically designed for the Airbus H135 aircraft.


The new product has received a Transport Canada Civil Aviation (TCCA) supplemental type certificate (STC) SH26-34, further expanding DART’s portfolio of certified external cargo solutions.


DART is excited to further support the Airbus H135 platform by introducing a new Heli-Utility-Basket that allows operators to expand their mission capabilities on this key platform.


DART Aerospace Photo


“With a 300-pound capacity, left- and right-hand options, and compatible pilot and passenger steps, the system provides a versatile solution for carrying mission equipment and cargo,” said Michael Lee, DART business unit manager. “Production is underway, with first deliveries scheduled for December.”


The Airbus H135 Heli-Utility-Basket features quick and easy installation, allowing operators to externally carry skis, cargo hooks, tools and equipment, and a variety of other items safely.


Developed for the utility and VIP market, this cargo basket is constructed of corrosion-resistant stainless steel, coated with a high-gloss, scratch-resistant white finish. Safety is enhanced with a simple self-locking handle that assures lid closure and secures cargo during flight. A gas spring is utilized to ease lid opening and closing.


With the launch of the Airbus H135 Heli-Utility-Basket and the achievement of TCCA STC SH26-34, DART continues to deliver innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of helicopter operators worldwide.


DART Aerospace Photo


As with most DART products, DART will support additional agency validations based on customer needs.


The New Airbus H135 Heli-Utility-Basket is now available on DART’s official website,[www.dartaerospace.com.](https://www.dartaerospace.com/) Please contact DART’s Sales team today atsales@dartaero.com for more information on pricing and lead time.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by DART Aerospace.*
